tolerance.note: |got-exp| <= abs + rel*|exp| for every double; strings, booleans, integers and ISO instants must match exactly

meta.zone: fixed offset +03:30 (Asia/Tehran, no DST). Local day = 00:00-24:00 in that zone; the week starts on Saturday.
meta.timeFormat: ISO-8601 with offset; engine tests parse them with java.time.OffsetDateTime
notes: Every case is {id, desc, input, expected}. Optional input.params overrides the default parameters (keys exactly as in defaultParams).
plan/leverageAdvisor/fill/sizeVerdict/curve/kpi are workbook-parity (same numbers as the Excel journal for the same inputs).
dashboard/governor scenarios additionally use the equity ledger (start-of-day equity is taken from the ledger, not from 'current equity minus today's P&L').
A trade input is raw; derived fields (rrisk, rriskp, verdict, net, R, ok) are expected output of the engine, listed under expected.trades when useful.
